integrity: The proof is an exact algebraic reduction of the published Floquet condition followed by elementary local asymptotics and harmonic summation. The bundled numerical checker is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the half-flux case \(\Phi=\pi\) with unit edge length and the source normalization.
No explicit constant is claimed for the bounded \(O(1)\) remainder, and no analogue is claimed for other flux denominators.
title: Exact half-flux spectral criterion and logarithmic deficit in the magnetic preferred-orientation square lattice
